display_long_description:
**Spacious Places** blends musical instruments with beautiful scenery to promote wellbeing and relaxation. Play along to peaceful songs using a variety of virtual instruments and experience the tranquility of natural environments.  NOTE: THIS IS NOT A MUSIC RHYTHM GAME
##
# MANY SPACIOUS ENVIRONMENTS
Experience 18 different environments, surrounded by the beauty and sounds of nature, from Mountains to Desert, Grassland to Forest, the Tropics and Jungle
[media] 
##
# A WIDE VARIETY OF INSTRUMENTS
Play 15 instruments with your hands or mallets including Harps, Chimes, Bells, Gong, Congas, Vibraphone, Xylophone, Handpan, Tank Drum, Kalimba, Balafon, and more.  
Create your own virtual sound bath, no musical ability required!
[media]
##
# CREATIVE INTERACTIONS
Creatively launch fireworks, bubbles, snowflakes, lanterns or just follow along with the breathing bubble
[media]
##
# DISCOVER PEACEFUL PLACES
The sounds and scenery in Spacious Places will transport you to a place of peace, rest, and calm
[media]
